I need to be wary of the hype and focus on building a diversified portfolio of major cryptocurrencies through gradual spot purchases. Leverage and high-risk trades are off the table for now.
react.plan: I will continue with my conservative 'accumulation' phase strategy this cycle, slowly building up my positions in BTC, ETH, and SOL through spot purchases.
